user_saw: Unfinished model reasoning appeared in the reply when a native tool call was followed by a token limit or content filter.
summary: The fix disables recovery of unclosed inline reasoning at native tool boundaries and preserves recovery on a normal terminal stop.
reasoning: The August commit named in the PR renamed an existing tool-boundary flush. The oldest available source already calls that flush on a native tool delta and allows it to emit unclosed reasoning as visible text in non-strict mode. The offline history stops at the shallow boundary, so I could not verify which commit introduced the behavior or whether it had previously worked.
